android.desc:
My Daily Task helps you build habits that actually stick — one day at a time.

Whether it's exercise, reading, drinking water, or anything else you're trying to make part of your life, My Daily Task keeps you accountable with a simple daily check-in, smart reminders, and a streak that grows the more consistent you are.

WHY MY DAILY TASK IS DIFFERENT

Shields protect your progress
Life happens. Miss a day here and there without losing everything — earn shields as you build your streak, and use them to protect a missed day instead of starting from zero. Beat your own personal best after a slip-up and you'll earn a bonus shield on top, with a moment to celebrate it.

Your momentum, visible at a glance
The longer a streak runs, the more it glows — a subtle visual cue that builds the more consistent you are, right on your calendar and your task list. No streak ever looks the same as day one.

Chain habits together
Link tasks so that finishing one surfaces the next — meditate, then journal; stretch, then hydrate. Build routines instead of a flat list of unrelated boxes.

Set your own challenges
Combine a handful of tasks into a timed challenge — 7, 14, 30, 60, or 90 days — with its own progress ring and day-by-day view, completely separate from your regular streaks. Every task still needs to be done on a given day for it to count, so a finished challenge actually means something.

Check things off without opening the app
Add a home-screen widget that shows today's tasks and lets you check them off directly — no need to open My Daily Task at all.

Real achievements, not just numbers
Level up Daily Streak, Task Completion, and Personal Best achievements for every habit — plus global achievements across everything you track, like Multitasker, Perfect Day, Shield Hoarder, and now Challenge Finisher and Long Haul for the challenges you complete. Confetti included.

Reminders that actually arrive
Notifications are scheduled to fire exactly on time, every day, even if the app is closed or your phone restarts. No vague "sometime today" reminders — just reliable nudges when you need them.

Make it yours
Give each habit its own emoji and color so your task list is easy to scan at a glance. Reorder tasks and challenges to match what matters most to you.

See your progress, not just today
A weekly view and 30-day completion rate for every task, so you can see the bigger picture beyond just today's streak.

Your data stays yours
No account,

quotes.title: My Daily Task – a habit tracker with no back end, no account
